picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Archam Manning has thrown forty-three touchdown passes, and Olivine has lost its 702-yard runner. I expect the Psi Corps to keep adding possessions while the visitors struggle to extend theirs.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: NeMarcus Tare and Chen Norton Jr have combined for fifty-two sacks. A backfield missing both Gabite and Gogoat leaves Drampa far too much protection work to solve with his arm.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Olivine earned this trip by recovering from a painful home loss, and its defense deserves credit for the shutout at Azalea. Saffron can still answer that resilience with several more scoring options.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Trent Scarboro has a 597-point offense and a clean injury report. The Ironclads scored 220 all season and just lost their leading runner; I cannot make those facts produce a polite margin.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Olivine can make Saffron work for an early lead, but the receiving depth around Manning should outlast an offense now missing Gabite and Gogoat. I expect the separation to grow across the game.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Vermilion has scored thirteen, seventeen and seventeen in its last three wins. Lavender has reached a higher offensive level, and I do not think the Volts can keep this to their preferred score.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Moth Ball has helped sustain wins through three different opponent tests. Vermilion is missing its 755-yard receiving leader, which makes matching even a moderate Lavender total difficult.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Travis Scarboro has kept the Wails moving after losing Mr. Clanky. I trust that continuity, although Vermilion has enough experience in close finishes to make the last quarter uncomfortable.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: I will give Lavender its division, its home game and a narrow win. I will not turn a plus-eight season differential into proof that Vermilion cannot make this awkward.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: The Wails have won eight straight and just handled the pressure of a division decider. Their passing improvement supplies more repeatable scoring than Vermilion has shown over its three narrow finishing wins.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Cinnabar has beaten Blackthorn and Mt. Silver during this four-game run. Exploud is a serious loss, but Gholdengo has shown enough distribution to keep the stronger recent offense ahead.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Hatterene completed 377 of 517 passes this season. With Cinnabar losing its 657-yard tight end in the finale, I favor the quarterback whose accuracy can keep the rematch moving despite the road setting.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Blackthorn lost a division by one point and has an immediate chance to recover. I still trust Cinnabar’s four straight wins, provided Gholdengo spreads the work that Exploud leaves behind.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Blaine beat these Dragons by twelve on their field and beat Mt. Silver by fourteen the following week. Exploud’s absence narrows the options; it does not erase what Gholdengo has built.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Cinnabar’s earlier road win and four-game finish give it a small edge. Hatterene should keep Blackthorn within one possession, while the Blaze need a collective answer to Exploud’s missing targets.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Hearthome’s five-win finish deserves attention, but Sunyshore has already scored eighty-one points in two meetings. I see improvement for the Haunts without enough improvement to reverse the matchup.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: The Starseekers have conceded ten points across the last two games. Their defense gives the offense time to work around 88 Special’s absence instead of needing an immediate shootout response.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Haunts have earned the right to be assessed as the team that finished, not only the team that lost by thirty-six. Sunyshore remains better, with the injury making this third meeting less comfortable.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Karson Jones already owns two convincing wins here. Hearthome can score more against a familiar opponent, but I expect Fera LaGatr and the Starseekers to keep the home crowd involved all afternoon.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Sunyshore’s two head-to-head wins and its closing defense outweigh Hearthome’s improved form. The absence of 88 Special should reduce some offensive flexibility, so I am projecting less than the fifty-three from the second meeting.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Rustboro has the higher scoring ceiling, and Petalburg is still missing its 957-yard runner. I expect Philly Gabite and Gibby Timmy to produce enough offense to make the third meeting different.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: Petalburg won both meetings, including the recent game in Rustboro. The Stone just conceded thirty-five; I need more than the promise of offensive improvement before picking them to reverse the matchup.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: The Pride have repeatedly won games that offer very little spare room. Oinkologne’s absence makes another close finish likely, and I give the home team a narrow edge in executing it.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: Tyler Scarboro’s offense put twenty-nine on Dewford and can attack a game without Oinkologne. I expect Rustboro to push the scoring beyond the modest total Petalburg would prefer.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Petalburg’s two head-to-head wins carry more weight than Rustboro’s extra points in a loss. The absent running back keeps this close, but the Pride have already demonstrated the defensive plan twice.

picks.author: rowan-vale
picks.reason: Dewford has just scored thirty-five on the road and has no positive-week injury entries. Eterna’s three important offensive absences make its usual small margin for error feel much smaller.

picks.author: mara-voss
picks.reason: The Thorns have a strong defense, but Slowking is being asked to work without the leading runner and a 375-yard tight end. Dewford can win this by building two proper touchdown drives.

picks.author: ellis-quill
picks.reason: Eterna’s defense has carried a season, so I expect it to give the crowd a game. Dewford has the healthier available group and enough recent offense to finish one possession better.

picks.author: dorian-pike
picks.reason: The Breakers scored thirty-five at Rustboro while Eterna managed nine against Snowpoint. The Thorns can make Brawly wait for his points; their injured offense makes a matching total difficult.

picks.author: tessa-wren
picks.reason: Eterna’s 184 points allowed keep this within reach, but Dewgong’s new injury joins Stantler and Tatsugiri on an already restrictive report. Dewford’s healthier offense gives it a slight road advantage.
